description:
## Empirical anchor

2026-05-13 surfaced by PRINCIPAL during the post-Arc-24 substrate-architecture discussion. The Stoa team architecture has two distinct teams per project, with clear separation of concerns:

- **Base team** — the standard Stoa team (POLYBIUS / PLINY / 10 CAPTAINs) deployed via install.sh. Kept in sync with the the-stoa repo via the existing substrate-update-check skill. Handles substrate maintenance + designs and modifies the project-specific team as needed.
- **Project-specific team** — authored by the base team via interaction with PRINCIPAL. Handles day-to-day project work. Specialized for the project's domain (Ariadne, Railway, Conan, etc.) through the project's files, tools, accumulated memories, and possibly new specialist agents.

The base team is the **forge**; the project team is the **shop**.

## The substrate-canon shape

Document the pattern in operating-disciplines.md (probably as a new section):

- The two teams' distinct concerns (substrate maintenance vs day-to-day project work)
- The directory convention for where each team's agents live in the project's `.claude/`
- The discipline that routes work appropriately: substrate-maintenance + project-team-modifications to base team; day-to-day work to project team
- How the base team designs the project team (PRINCIPAL interaction; agent-author skill; possibly an extension of tier2-project-onboarding)
- How keeping the base team in sync with the-stoa repo works (existing check-substrate-updates skill; explicit reference to it)

## Substrate touch-points

- `substrate/operating-disciplines.md` — new section on two-team architecture
- `substrate/MAJOR_POLYBIUS.md` — discipline note: base team's role includes designing + maintaining the project team
- `substrate/MAJOR_PLINY.md` — analogous discipline note
- Possibly: extend `substrate/skills/tier2-project-onboarding/` with a project-team-design phase
- Possibly: clarify install.sh's deploy convention for the two-team directory layout

## Gauntlet

DAEDALUS + ARGUS + ADA + CATO. Substrate-prose edit. ~80-150 LOC across op-disc + 2 role files + possibly the onboarding skill.

## Sequencing

P2. Arc 25 candidate. Bundles naturally with the other architectural-canon tickets (memory-as-alignment, multi-team pattern, operating-mode progression, handoff-author skill).

## Cross-references

- `stoa--7e3` — handoff-author skill (work-state continuity across compactions; sibling architectural-canon)
- `substrate/skills/check-substrate-updates/` — keeps base team in sync with the-stoa
- `substrate/skills/agent-author/` — authors new agents (project-team specialists)
- `substrate/skills/tier2-project-onboarding/` — current onboarding routine; may extend
